title: Eric Bauza, Filipino-Canadian 'Looney Tunes' voice actor, dies at 46
summary: Eric Bauza, the voice actor behind iconic Looney Tunes characters such as Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck, has died at the age of 46, his family announced Monday.
